_note: Look of the road tiles, not rules. obstacles: the kind of 3D obstacle standing on a face's impassable spaces (rocks, mesa, ruin, bunker, barricade), chosen after what the printed tile shows; 'default' is for faces not listed. formation: sizes of every formation of obstacles (design/gdd/terrain-generation.md), heights in spaces (1 = a space's width): base_h one space alone, grow more per further space of the group, max_h the cap, inset the margin kept from the outline of its own spaces. kinds: the profile of each kind: h scales the heights, edge how far in from the rim the side climbs (small = cliff and flat top, large = peak), power bends the side, noise and crest add lumps and a sharp ridge (shares of the height).
